hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.

UnderstandingNano offers information about nanoparticles, nanomaterials, and applications of
nanotechnology in several fields. In addition, you’ll find resources for finding nanotechnology
degree programs, research labs, and companies. Find information on nano topics by using the
navigation bar above or by clicking any of the links below.  

## What is Nanotechnology?

If you’re new to nanotechnology, this group of webpages provides an excellent [introduction ][60]to
the topic with definitions of various nanotechnology terms and applications. In addition you’ll find
a discussion of the important topic of the ethics of nanotechnology.  

## Get to Know All About Nanoparticles

The [nanoparticle webpages][61] have been updated to give you an introduction to particles made from
materials ranging from gold to lipids and titanium dioxide. The properties and applications of these
various types of particles are also provided, as well as a discussion of methods of nanoparticle
synthesis.        

## Exploring the World of Nanomaterials

Nanomaterials can take several forms from single atom thick sheets to nano composites. This section
provides information on a variety of [nanomaterials][62], from fullerenes to  carbon nanotubes and
quantum dots, including information about their composition and uses.  

## Getting to Work: Nanotechnology Applications

So how exactly is nanotechnology being used in the world? This group of webpages discusses the [
applications of nanotechnology][63] ranging from improving air quality to manufacturing and
 spaceflight.   Improving Your Health with Nanomedicine This topic includes discussions of the use
of nanotechnology in medical areas such as drug delivery, diagnostic techniques, and chemotherapy.
You’ll even find ways that nanotechnology is working on extending your life.  

##  Resources to Learn and Find Careers in Nanotechnology

The focus of this section is on [resources][64] you can make use of to get your degree in
nanotechnology, find companies that offer nano-oriented jobs, and even work with lesson plans to
teach others about this fascinating topic.

## Get to Know All About Nanoparticles

The [nanoparticle webpages][61] have been updated to give you an introduction to particles made from
materials ranging from gold to lipids and titanium dioxide. The properties and applications of these
various types of particles are also provided, as well as a discussion of methods of nanoparticle
synthesis.        

## Exploring the World of Nanomaterials

Nanomaterials can take several forms from single atom thick sheets to nano composites. This section
provides information on a variety of [nanomaterials][62], from fullerenes to  carbon nanotubes and
quantum dots, including information about their composition and uses.  

## Getting to Work: Nanotechnology Applications

So how exactly is nanotechnology being used in the world? This group of webpages discusses the [
applications of nanotechnology][63] ranging from improving air quality to manufacturing and
 spaceflight.   Improving Your Health with Nanomedicine This topic includes discussions of the use
of nanotechnology in medical areas such as drug delivery, diagnostic techniques, and chemotherapy.
You’ll even find ways that nanotechnology is working on extending your life.  

##  Resources to Learn and Find Careers in Nanotechnology

The focus of this section is on [resources][64] you can make use of to get your degree in
nanotechnology, find companies that offer nano-oriented jobs, and even work with lesson plans to
teach others about this fascinating topic.

  outcomes
* [ Nutritional Care ][13]

* [ Respiratory Health ][14]

  mobility

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

## Frequently Asked Questions

Answers to common questions about Veterinary APIs, Human APIs, bulk supply, exports, and contract
manufacturing.

Who is the leading Veterinary API manufacturer in India?

Aarambh Life Science is a GMP-certified Veterinary API manufacturer in India, supplying high-quality
active pharmaceutical ingredients for animal healthcare applications worldwide.

Do you manufacture both Veterinary APIs and Human APIs?

Yes, Aarambh Life Science manufactures and supplies a wide range of Veterinary APIs and Human APIs
for pharmaceutical companies globally.

How do I choose a reliable API manufacturer in India?

When selecting an API manufacturer, consider GMP compliance, product quality, manufacturing
capabilities, regulatory standards, documentation support, and supply reliability. Aarambh Life
Science follows stringent quality practices and provides reliable API supply solutions for
pharmaceutical companies.

Is Aarambh Life Science a GMP-certified API manufacturer?

Yes, we follow GMP-compliant manufacturing processes and stringent quality standards to ensure
product safety and consistency.

Do you export APIs internationally?

Yes, we export Veterinary APIs and Human APIs to pharmaceutical companies, distributors, and

Industries with robust R&D Division at Tarapur, Maharashtra Industrial Development Corporation
(MIDC) in close vicinity to manufacturing locations.

  Intermediates, Specialty Chemicals and also produces Formulations with its wholly-owned subsidiary
  – Pinnacle Life Science Private Limited.

exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one

India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

quality pharmaceutical products for franchise business and third party manufacturing services. The
company work under the norms set by the (WHO) World Health Organisation and (GMP) Goods

### **AMERICAN ENERGY SECURITY FRAMEWORK**

Recent geopolitical disruptions and their impact on global energy markets have been a stark reminder
that energy security remains inseparable from economic security and geopolitical stability. The
United States is better positioned than most nations to navigate market volatility, thanks to
decades of investment and innovation that made America the world's leading producer of oil and
natural gas and a reliable supplier to global markets. But future disruptions will require a
stronger, more flexible energy system—one built on secure supply, modern infrastructure and
resilience.

The following recommendations provide a framework for getting there.

SECURE AMERICAN ENERGY SUPPLY
* Develop a Robust Federal Offshore Leasing Program
* Ensure Stable, Consistent Fuel Supply Through a Functional Renewable Fuel Standard
* Optimize the Strategic Petroleum Reserve

BUILD INFRASTRUCTURE AND MOVE ENERGY
* Pass Comprehensive Permitting Reform
* Improve the Jones Act to Unlock Domestic Energy Flexibility
* Provide Relief from Unnecessary Tariffs on Critical Energy Inputs

STRENGTHEN RESILIENCE AND SUPPLY CHAINS
* Work with Persian Gulf Allies to Reduce Reliance on the Strait of Hormuz
* Strengthen Western Hemisphere Energy Security

### **AMERICAN ENERGY SECURITY FRAMEWORK**

Recent geopolitical disruptions and their impact on global energy markets have been a stark reminder
that energy security remains inseparable from economic security and geopolitical stability. The
United States is better positioned than most nations to navigate market volatility, thanks to
decades of investment and innovation that made America the world's leading producer of oil and
natural gas and a reliable supplier to global markets. But future disruptions will require a
stronger, more flexible energy system—one built on secure supply, modern infrastructure and
resilience.

The following recommendations provide a framework for getting there.

SECURE AMERICAN ENERGY SUPPLY
* Develop a Robust Federal Offshore Leasing Program
* Ensure Stable, Consistent Fuel Supply Through a Functional Renewable Fuel Standard
* Optimize the Strategic Petroleum Reserve

BUILD INFRASTRUCTURE AND MOVE ENERGY
* Pass Comprehensive Permitting Reform
* Improve the Jones Act to Unlock Domestic Energy Flexibility
* Provide Relief from Unnecessary Tariffs on Critical Energy Inputs

STRENGTHEN RESILIENCE AND SUPPLY CHAINS
* Work with Persian Gulf Allies to Reduce Reliance on the Strait of Hormuz
* Strengthen Western Hemisphere Energy Security

**ANGIPLAST Pvt. Ltd.** a leading **[Medical Disposable manufacturing Company][121]** have ISO
9001,ISO 13485,CE,USFDA,GMP, and GLP Certificates looking for Distributors for their following
product in all major cities/towns.

**DISTRIBUTORS WANTED FOR BLOOD TUBING FOR HAEMODIALYSIS**

Selected Distributors will be considered for area-wise or one-for-all on long term business
partnership based on mutual agreement.

Bloodtubing set has been specially designed for the patient to connect external system which
extracts patient’s blood to the dialyzer and then returns patient’s blood from the dialyzer. We are

## Welcome to Biomedical Journal

Biomedical Journal of Scientific & Technical Research (BJSTR - [www.biomedres.us][71]) is a
multidisciplinary, scholarly [Open Access publisher][72] focused on Genetic, Biomedical and Remedial
missions in relation with Technical Knowledge as well. We crave to select ground-breaking research
based on modernism, aptness, scientific connotation, prospective spectator interests, etc. We

  markets around the globe

specializing in formulation development, clinical and commercial cGMP manufacturing, and packaging
of complex oral solid dose, liquid, semi-solid, biologic, and sterile injectable pharmaceutical

facilities work seamlessly together with a shared commitment to supporting partners, minimizing

Working for a Safer Drug Supply Chain

The Bulk Pharmaceuticals Task Force (BPTF) is an industry trade organization representing
manufacturers of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), intermediates and excipients. BPTF
addresses regulatory and quality issues related to current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP)
compliance.

Quality Performance

BPTF is focused on quality throughout the supply chain. Creating a quality culture in manufacturing
requires dilligence and a need to keep informed and aware of ever-changing regulatory guidance
and industry standards.

 

Engaged

BPTF is a key stakeholder in negotiations with FDA on authorization of the Generic Drug User Fee
Amendments (GDUFA) and works with an array of industry trade groups to stay abreast of all
developments in the drug industry.

Advocacy

BPTF is a trusted industry voice respected within the drug supply chain and trusted by influential
leaders working on supply chain safety.

Working for a Safer Drug Supply Chain

The Bulk Pharmaceuticals Task Force (BPTF) is an industry trade organization representing
manufacturers of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), intermediates and excipients. BPTF
addresses regulatory and quality issues related to current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP)
compliance. 

 

 

[Prescription Drugs]
[[Bar Chart]][11]
[[FDA-White-Oak-Building-01.jpg]][12]
[[Business Brainstorm]][13]

Quality Performance

BPTF is focused on quality throughout the supply chain. Creating a quality culture in manufacturing
requires dilligence and a need to keep informed and aware of ever-changing regulatory guidance
and industry standards.

 

Engaged

BPTF is a key stakeholder in negotiations with FDA on authorization of the Generic Drug User Fee
Amendments (GDUFA) and works with an array of industry trade groups to stay abreast of all
developments in the drug industry.

Advocacy

BPTF is a trusted industry voice respected within the drug supply chain and trusted by influential
leaders working on supply chain safety.

The Problem With Analysts

## They're slow. They're expensive.
## *And they're keeping your data hostage.*

01
They're wrong more than you think.

Analysts aren't oracles. They're people working with the same public data you could access yourself
— just a few weeks later, after three rounds of internal review, dressed up in a 60-page PDF with a
lot of confident language.

**The data doesn't get better in the meantime.** A patent expiry date is a patent expiry date. The
FDA docket says what it says. You're not paying for insight. You're paying for someone else's
reading of the same primary sources — with their biases baked in.

"Analysts add interpretation. Not always accuracy."
02
By the time it lands, it's old.

Drug markets move fast. A competitor files an ANDA. A court issues an injunction. A biosimilar gets
the nod. These things happen on a Tuesday.

## Frequently Asked Question

### 1. What does Farbe Firma specialize in manufacturing?

We are a specialized pharmaceutical formulation manufacturer focusing on Critical Care Injectables.
Our capabilities include liquid ampoules, sterile vials, Lyophilized (Freeze-Dried) injections, and
lipid emulsions across therapeutic areas like Anaesthesia, Pain Management, and Anti-infectives.


### 2. Are your manufacturing facilities WHO-GMP certified?

Yes, our manufacturing facility in Ankleshwar, Gujarat, is WHO-GMP certified. We adhere strictly to
global pharmacopeial standards (USP/BP/IP) and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) to ensure the
highest sterility and quality for international markets.


### 3. Do you offer Contract Manufacturing (CMO) and CDMO services?

Yes, we provide comprehensive Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) services.
We support global pharmaceutical companies with formulation development, private label
manufacturing, and scale-up of sterile injectables under their own brand names.


### 4. Which countries do you currently export to?

Farbe Firma exports to over 30 countries across Latin America, Africa, CIS, Southeast Asia, and the
Middle East. We have a dedicated export department that manages logistics and supply chain
compliance for global partners.


### 5. Do you provide Regulatory Dossiers and registration support?

Absolutely. We support our partners with complete regulatory documentation, including Dossiers
(CTD/ACTD formats), Certificates of Analysis (COA), and Stability Data to facilitate smooth product
registration in your local market.


### 6. How can I request a price quote or product sample?

For bulk inquiries, contract manufacturing proposals, or sample requests, please contact our export
team directly at [director@farbefirma.org][57] or via WhatsApp at +91 932 797 4224.

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

### Specialization

## Validated Cold Chain Shipment

Our cold chain service protects pharmaceuticals by maintaining strict temperature control during
transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

### Validated Packaging

Our packaging solutions are scientifically tested and qualified to maintain target temperatures for
extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

### Global Compliance

Every shipment aligns with GDP, GMP, and international health authority guidelines to ensure
traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

FAQ

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

Why Inspire

## Specialty supply is a clinical decision — we treat it that way.

Specialty medicines aren't ordinary stock. A delayed oncology cycle, a missed dialysis session, an
ICU drug that didn't make it through customs — each one shows up in patient outcomes.

Inspire was built to remove those failures from the supply side. We focus narrowly on four specialty
areas, we keep the same molecules in stock month after month, and we are accountable for the chain
from manufacturer to hospital pharmacy.

[More about Inspire][20]
What we do for clinicians and procurement

## Registered. Sourced. Delivered — to clinical specification.

We are organised around what hospital pharmacy, oncology day-care units, dialysis centres and tender
boards actually need: a known supplier, a registered product, and dependable lead time.

### Scientific office support

Our in-house medical team works directly with prescribers — protocol fit, mechanism of action,
contraindications and SmPC documentation. Specialty supply backed by clinical understanding, not
just a sales call.

### Cold-chain reliability

Biologics, plasma-derived therapies and selected oncology agents are handled with
temperature-controlled logistics, transit monitoring and conditioned warehousing — verified at
hospital goods-in.

### Hospital & tender supply

Direct supply to private & public hospitals, oncology day-care units, dialysis providers, and county
/ national pharmaceutical tenders.

[Full capabilities][21]
Built around the prescriber

## The people who choose the medicine are the people we work for.

Oncologists, nephrologists, hospital pharmacists, intensivists, procurement officers — these are the
audiences our scientific office, regulatory team and supply chain are designed around.

If you are one of them and you need product information, supply confirmation or a tender response,
our team is one enquiry away.

[Contact our team][22]

The government's decision to reduce GST rates is a commendable step towards enhancing affordability
and supporting public welfare.

Starting 22nd September 2025, we’ve lowered the prices of our products to match the recent GST rate
cut. This change shows our commitment to making healthcare more affordable.

All partners must bill at the new prices and make sure customers get the full benefit of the GST
reduction.

## "Strive not to be a success, but rather to be of value!"

### Khandelwal Associates is a Pharmaceutical Logistics Company, established in the year 1989.
### Providing services to more than 700 clients since 33 years. The firm majors in four services
### which are Carrying and Forwarding Agency Consignee Agency, Distributorship and Mother Warehouse
### Facility. Infrastructure with ultra-modern IT facilities and spacious warehouses. Provision of

* 1989 : Our company was incorporated as Khandelwal Associatel, established in year 1989, as a
  Pharmaceutical Company in Indore. The foundation of our enterprise were laid with a passionate
  vision and the aim to achieve unparalleled success.
* 1995 : After years of conscientious practice in Pharmaceutical Business, we became associated with
  one of the top firms in the Pharmaceutical field, Emcure Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd.
* 2003 - 2004 : We established our main head office in indore with in house facilities for
  hospitality, support, operations, cold chain facilities, material handeling and three warehouses.
  Also got associated with Zuventus Healthcare Ltd.
* 2005 : Association with Medopharm Pharmaceuticals.
* 2008 - 2011 : Collaborated with Adley Labs, Gennova Biopharmaceuticals, Cachet Pharmaceuticals
  Private Limited and Talent Healthcare.
* 2013 - 2014 : We became C&F agents for Koey Pharmaceuticals and also became Adley Mother Warehouse
  Facility.

## Services

"To give real service you must add something which cannot be bought or measured with money, and that
is sincerity and integrity."

#### Carrying & Forwarding Agent

As a carrying and forwarding agent receiving the goods from the factories, warehousing these goods,
receiving dispatch orders from the principal, and much more.

#### Consignee Agent

As a consignee agent, the company's name is reflected in the consignee column in the bill of lading
or in other words the “buyer” of the cargo.

#### Mother Warehouse Facility

A mother warehouse is a commercial building for storage of goods. Mother Warehouses are used by
exporters, wholesalers, transport businesses, etc.

#### Distributorship

It’s about getting the right medicines to the right patients at the right time, safely and
efficiently. Primary distributors sustain a complex supply chain.

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## publics

Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

a review process by the reviewer maximum in 5 days, followed by revision/publication in 2 days. If
the article gets notified for revision by the handling editor, then it will take another 5 days for
external review by the previous reviewer or alternative reviewer.

independent peer-review, ensuring the highest standards are maintained no matter the route to
regular peer-reviewed publication or a fast editorial review process. The handling editor and the
article contributor are responsible for adhering to scientific standards. The article FEE-Review
process of $99 will not be refunded even if the article is rejected or withdrawn for publication.

The corresponding author or institution/organization is responsible for making the manuscript
FEE-Review Process payment. The additional FEE-Review Process payment covers the fast review
processing and quick editorial decisions, and regular article publication covers the preparation in
various formats for online publication, securing full-text inclusion in a number of permanent
archives like HTML, XML, and PDF, and feeding to different indexing agencies.

*NanoImprove* the performance of your small- and large-molecule formulations — from early
development through to lifecycle management — by enabling higher drug loads in smaller tablets, in
subcutaneous injections, and alternative delivery formats.

Achieve improved bioavailability, higher drug loading and novel drug delivery for your small
molecule therapeutics, enabled by best-in-class nanotechnology, expert formulation and scalable GMP
supply.

## Nanoforming Biologics & GLP-1s: From I.V. to Sub Q & Inhaled Delivery

Designing the most patient-centric and effective treatment options are key for those pharmaceutical
companies developing and marketing high value biological therapies. Nanoforming biologics and
peptides simplifies dose regimens and unlocks new delivery routes to enhance patient comfort,
compliance and reduce healthcare costs.

[ Learn more ][131]

## Improving bioavailability

Many of the latest generation of small molecule drugs in development exhibit increased molecular
weights and lipophilicity. Today’s novel, complex molecules present not only biopharmaceutical
challenges such as poor solubility and bioavailability, but also handling and manufacturing
challenges.

[ Learn more ][132]

## Enabling Subcutaneous Delivery for Improved Patient Compliance & Healthcare System Efficiencies

Nanoform Biologics’ high-dose subcutaneous delivery platform represents a significant advancement in
the field of biologics.

[ Learn more ][133]

## Expanding Opportunities for Inhaled Drug Delivery

Whether to treat localised respiratory disease, or because the lung provides a fast, non-invasive,
and efficient route of delivery for systemic effect, the administration of pharmaceuticals to the
lung is gaining increased attention; even beyond treatments for globally prevalent diseases like
asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD).

### About our parent company

[ [Sekhmet_Logo] ][47]

In May 2022, [Sekhmet Pharmaventures][48] acquired a majority stake in Optimus Drugs Group of
Companies, marking a pivotal step in our evolution.

Sekhmet Pharmaventures Pvt. Ltd. (part of Gamot API Pte Ltd. based in Singapore) was formed by Asian
private equity major PAG, along with Indian private equity firms, CX Partners and Samara Capital.
The three has formed an investment platform called Gamot API Pte. Ltd. based in Singapore, with the
aim to buy stakes in fast-growing pharma companies. Sekhmet Pharmaventures continues to combine
inorganic endeavors together with organic growth activities, in order to form a leading Pharma
platform in the spaces of intermediates, API, Finished Dosage Formulations and CMO & CDMO services.

## Three decades of innovation in drug delivery & product development

1995

Orexo is founded in Uppsala, Sweden, as a drug delivery company. Development begins based on
first-generation drug delivery technology – the sublingual platform

2000

Diabact® UBT, for diagnosing Helicobacter pylori, receives first market approval and is
commercialized through a partner

2008

Abstral®, for breakthrough cancer pain, launches in its first market via partnership

2009

Edluar®, for insomnia, achieves first market approval and is commercialized through partnership

2013

Zubsolv®, the third product based on the sublingual platform, is approved by the FDA for the
treatment of opioid addiction. Orexo establishes a US subsidiary for commercialization

2016

Zubsolv in the US surpasses SEK 1 billion in gross sales

2017

Research into an overdose rescue medication started, leading to the development of next-generation
drug delivery technology - AmorphOX®

2021

Pipeline expands with three clinical-phase programs and several preclinical projects all leveraging
AmorphOX technology

2024

Clinical expansion in the development of a powder-based nasal anaphylaxis product. In parallel,
Orexo expands research in peptides and vaccines.

2025

Orexo divests all rights to Zubsolv in the US, unlocking resources to accelerate development
programs

### Product Range


#### Tablets

Pharmaceutical tablets are a widely used form of medication delivery in the healthcare industry.
These small, solid, and easily consumable pills are designed to contain specific active ingredients
that provide therapeutic effects. The content of these tablets can vary greatly depending on the
intended use of the medication.


#### Syrups

Pharmaceutical syrups play a crucial role in the healthcare industry, serving as a convenient and
effective way to deliver medications to patients. These liquid formulations are specially designed
to ensure accurate dosing and ease of administration, making them particularly suitable for
children, elderly individuals.


#### Ointment

Ointments are specialized semi-solid formulations applied to the skin or mucous membranes for
various therapeutic or protective purposes. At Richberg Healthcare Pvt. Ltd , we follow rigorous
manufacturing processes to ensure the highest quality in every batch of ointments produced.


#### Respules

"Respules" refers to a specific form of nebulizer medication, typically in a liquid-filled ampoule,
that is designed for inhalation to treat respiratory conditions like asthma or chronic obstructive
pulmonary disease (COPD). These are often produced by pharmaceutical companies specializing in
respiratory care and medications.


#### Capsules

Capsules are a widely used pharmaceutical dosage form, known for their convenience and effectiveness
in delivering medication to patients. These small, cylindrical containers consist of two halves,
typically made of gelatin or a suitable alternative material, that encase the active ingredients in
a precise and measured manner.


#### Injection

Injection manufacturing, particularly for pharmaceuticals, involves stringent processes to ensure
sterility, accuracy, and efficacy. Injectable medications are commonly used for rapid, controlled
delivery of drugs, and they require precise manufacturing steps due to their direct delivery into
the bloodstream, muscles, or tissues.

### Product Range


#### Tablets

Pharmaceutical tablets are a widely used form of medication delivery in the healthcare industry.
These small, solid, and easily consumable pills are designed to contain specific active ingredients
that provide therapeutic effects. The content of these tablets can vary greatly depending on the
intended use of the medication.


#### Syrups

Pharmaceutical syrups play a crucial role in the healthcare industry, serving as a convenient and
effective way to deliver medications to patients. These liquid formulations are specially designed
to ensure accurate dosing and ease of administration, making them particularly suitable for
children, elderly individuals.


#### Ointment

Ointments are specialized semi-solid formulations applied to the skin or mucous membranes for
various therapeutic or protective purposes. At Richberg Healthcare Pvt. Ltd , we follow rigorous
manufacturing processes to ensure the highest quality in every batch of ointments produced.


#### Respules

"Respules" refers to a specific form of nebulizer medication, typically in a liquid-filled ampoule,
that is designed for inhalation to treat respiratory conditions like asthma or chronic obstructive
pulmonary disease (COPD). These are often produced by pharmaceutical companies specializing in
respiratory care and medications.


#### Capsules

Capsules are a widely used pharmaceutical dosage form, known for their convenience and effectiveness
in delivering medication to patients. These small, cylindrical containers consist of two halves,
typically made of gelatin or a suitable alternative material, that encase the active ingredients in
a precise and measured manner.


#### Injection

Injection manufacturing, particularly for pharmaceuticals, involves stringent processes to ensure
sterility, accuracy, and efficacy. Injectable medications are commonly used for rapid, controlled
delivery of drugs, and they require precise manufacturing steps due to their direct delivery into
the bloodstream, muscles, or tissues.

## best Services & Products

UnderstandingNano offers information about nanoparticles, nanomaterials, and applications of
nanotechnology in several fields. In addition, you’ll find resources for finding nanotechnology
degree programs, research labs, and companies. Find information on nano topics by using the
navigation bar above or by clicking any of the links below.  

## What is Nanotechnology?

If you’re new to nanotechnology, this group of webpages provides an excellent [introduction ][60]to
the topic with definitions of various nanotechnology terms and applications. In addition you’ll find
a discussion of the important topic of the ethics of nanotechnology.  

## Get to Know All About Nanoparticles

The [nanoparticle webpages][61] have been updated to give you an introduction to particles made from
materials ranging from gold to lipids and titanium dioxide. The properties and applications of these
various types of particles are also provided, as well as a discussion of methods of nanoparticle
synthesis.        

## Exploring the World of Nanomaterials

Nanomaterials can take several forms from single atom thick sheets to nano composites. This section
provides information on a variety of [nanomaterials][62], from fullerenes to  carbon nanotubes and
quantum dots, including information about their composition and uses.  

## Getting to Work: Nanotechnology Applications

So how exactly is nanotechnology being used in the world? This group of webpages discusses the [
applications of nanotechnology][63] ranging from improving air quality to manufacturing and
 spaceflight.   Improving Your Health with Nanomedicine This topic includes discussions of the use
of nanotechnology in medical areas such as drug delivery, diagnostic techniques, and chemotherapy.
You’ll even find ways that nanotechnology is working on extending your life.  

##  Resources to Learn and Find Careers in Nanotechnology

The focus of this section is on [resources][64] you can make use of to get your degree in
nanotechnology, find companies that offer nano-oriented jobs, and even work with lesson plans to
teach others about this fascinating topic.

# Living our mission of creating healthier, happier communities globally

[Zydus Srishti][15]

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Major Areas of Research

[NCE Research] **NCE Research**
* Cardio-Metabolic
* Inflammation and Immunology,
* Neurosciences, Oncology, Rare Diseases
[Biologics] **Biologics**
* Biosimilar Therapeutic proteins
* Biosimilar Monoclonal antibodies
* Biobetters and Novel biologics
[Vaccines] **Vaccines**
* Infectious diseases

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.

Industries with robust R&D Division at Tarapur, Maharashtra Industrial Development Corporation

exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

### **AMERICAN ENERGY SECURITY FRAMEWORK**

Recent geopolitical disruptions and their impact on global energy markets have been a stark reminder
that energy security remains inseparable from economic security and geopolitical stability. The
United States is better positioned than most nations to navigate market volatility, thanks to
decades of investment and innovation that made America the world's leading producer of oil and
natural gas and a reliable supplier to global markets. But future disruptions will require a
stronger, more flexible energy system—one built on secure supply, modern infrastructure and
resilience.

The following recommendations provide a framework for getting there.

SECURE AMERICAN ENERGY SUPPLY
* Develop a Robust Federal Offshore Leasing Program
* Ensure Stable, Consistent Fuel Supply Through a Functional Renewable Fuel Standard
* Optimize the Strategic Petroleum Reserve

BUILD INFRASTRUCTURE AND MOVE ENERGY
* Pass Comprehensive Permitting Reform
* Improve the Jones Act to Unlock Domestic Energy Flexibility
* Provide Relief from Unnecessary Tariffs on Critical Energy Inputs

STRENGTHEN RESILIENCE AND SUPPLY CHAINS
* Work with Persian Gulf Allies to Reduce Reliance on the Strait of Hormuz
* Strengthen Western Hemisphere Energy Security

conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation

## Welcome to Biomedical Journal

Biomedical Journal of Scientific & Technical Research (BJSTR - [www.biomedres.us][71]) is a
multidisciplinary, scholarly [Open Access publisher][72] focused on Genetic, Biomedical and Remedial
missions in relation with Technical Knowledge as well. We crave to select ground-breaking research
based on modernism, aptness, scientific connotation, prospective spectator interests, etc. We
endeavor to provide by far and liberally accessible belvedere to researchers and practitioners in
support of their novel and valuable ideas. We already have 2000+ [Editorial Board][73] members along
with 5000+ [Published articles][74] in our box. Our BJSTR maintains a scrupulous, methodical, fair
[peer review process][75]. Besides, quality control is riveted in each step of the publication
process.

#### Aim & Scope

We aim to frame tremendous standard international academic journals and strive to provide a
congenial and candidly attainable podium for researchers all over the world to present their
research victories and to reciprocate their ideas.

[  Read More ][76]

#### What do we do?

The BJSTR is an open access medical and clinical research publication that gives acclaimed
scientific authors and research experts a global platform to share their work among like-minded
peers and help accumulate scientific knowledge in a singular repository.

[  Read More ][77]

#### Why publish with us?

Our production process follows a high standard to ensure quality publications. All manuscripts are
endured to high level terminology compilation and bursting amendments, as well as being processed
through QC progressions, to ensure trustworthiness.

[  Read More ][78]

## The biotech catalyst calendar, built for investors

CatalystAlert is a [biotech catalyst calendar][27] that tracks every market-moving event for 1,726+
biopharma companies — [FDA PDUFA decision dates][28], [Phase 3 trial readouts][29], [FDA advisory
committee meetings][30], and [every other catalyst type][31]. Each date is confidence-rated —
confirmed against an official regulatory source, estimated, or AI-detected — so you always know how
firm a biopharmaceutical catalyst really is. Check [this week's catalysts][32] or the signal-ranked
[Catalyst Radar][33] to see what's coming next.

## Frequently asked questions

What is CatalystAlert?

CatalystAlert is a biotech catalyst tracking platform with AI-powered predictions that helps
investors monitor PDUFA dates, clinical trial results, FDA decisions, and predict stock price
movements for 1,600+ biotechnology companies.

How much does CatalystAlert cost?

CatalystAlert offers a free tier with a 7-day catalyst calendar view, company search and a
watchlist. Pro is $29.99/mo and unlocks the full calendar horizon plus AI predictions and alerts —
and starts with a 48-hour free trial (card required; cancel anytime before it ends and you are not
charged). Elite tier ($99.99/mo) coming soon with API access.

Where does CatalystAlert get its data?

CatalystAlert aggregates data from official sources including ClinicalTrials.gov, SEC EDGAR filings,
FDA openFDA database, EMA, and company press releases. Our ML models are trained on historical
catalyst outcomes with price data — see our public track record for how they have actually
performed.

What types of biotech catalysts are tracked?

We track PDUFA dates, Phase 1/2/3 clinical trial results, FDA Advisory Committee meetings (AdCom),
NDA/BLA filings, earnings reports, conference presentations, EMA approvals, and other regulatory
events worldwide.

How does CatalystAlert analyze catalysts?

We analyze catalyst characteristics, therapeutic area, clinical phase, FDA designations, historical
patterns, and market conditions to help you understand potential stock price impacts. Our
data-driven approach combines multiple factors for comprehensive catalyst analysis.

## Frequently asked questions

What is CatalystAlert?

CatalystAlert is a biotech catalyst tracking platform with AI-powered predictions that helps
investors monitor PDUFA dates, clinical trial results, FDA decisions, and predict stock price
movements for 1,600+ biotechnology companies.

How much does CatalystAlert cost?

CatalystAlert offers a free tier with a 7-day catalyst calendar view, company search and a
watchlist. Pro is $29.99/mo and unlocks the full calendar horizon plus AI predictions and alerts —
and starts with a 48-hour free trial (card required; cancel anytime before it ends and you are not
charged). Elite tier ($99.99/mo) coming soon with API access.

Where does CatalystAlert get its data?

CatalystAlert aggregates data from official sources including ClinicalTrials.gov, SEC EDGAR filings,
FDA openFDA database, EMA, and company press releases. Our ML models are trained on historical
catalyst outcomes with price data — see our public track record for how they have actually
performed.

What types of biotech catalysts are tracked?

We track PDUFA dates, Phase 1/2/3 clinical trial results, FDA Advisory Committee meetings (AdCom),
NDA/BLA filings, earnings reports, conference presentations, EMA approvals, and other regulatory
events worldwide.

How does CatalystAlert analyze catalysts?

We analyze catalyst characteristics, therapeutic area, clinical phase, FDA designations, historical
patterns, and market conditions to help you understand potential stock price impacts. Our
data-driven approach combines multiple factors for comprehensive catalyst analysis.

What is Likelihood of Approval (LOA)?

LOA is a probability score predicting the chance of FDA approval for a drug based on its phase,
therapeutic area, trial design, and special designations like Breakthrough Therapy or Fast Track.
Our Logistic Regression model is calibrated against BIO industry benchmarks.

How often is the data updated?

Core data syncs every 2-6 hours from official government databases. ML models are retrained weekly
with new outcomes. Real-time alerts notify subscribers within minutes of major announcements.

Can I get alerts for specific catalysts?

Yes! Create a watchlist of companies you follow and enable push notifications to receive instant
alerts when catalysts approach, results are announced, or significant price movements occur.

## Frequently Asked Question

### 1. What does Farbe Firma specialize in manufacturing?

We are a specialized pharmaceutical formulation manufacturer focusing on Critical Care Injectables.
Our capabilities include liquid ampoules, sterile vials, Lyophilized (Freeze-Dried) injections, and
lipid emulsions across therapeutic areas like Anaesthesia, Pain Management, and Anti-infectives.


### 2. Are your manufacturing facilities WHO-GMP certified?

Yes, our manufacturing facility in Ankleshwar, Gujarat, is WHO-GMP certified. We adhere strictly to
global pharmacopeial standards (USP/BP/IP) and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) to ensure the
highest sterility and quality for international markets.


### 3. Do you offer Contract Manufacturing (CMO) and CDMO services?

Yes, we provide comprehensive Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) services.
We support global pharmaceutical companies with formulation development, private label
manufacturing, and scale-up of sterile injectables under their own brand names.


### 4. Which countries do you currently export to?

Farbe Firma exports to over 30 countries across Latin America, Africa, CIS, Southeast Asia, and the
Middle East. We have a dedicated export department that manages logistics and supply chain
compliance for global partners.


### 5. Do you provide Regulatory Dossiers and registration support?

Absolutely. We support our partners with complete regulatory documentation, including Dossiers
(CTD/ACTD formats), Certificates of Analysis (COA), and Stability Data to facilitate smooth product
registration in your local market.


### 6. How can I request a price quote or product sample?

For bulk inquiries, contract manufacturing proposals, or sample requests, please contact our export
team directly at [director@farbefirma.org][57] or via WhatsApp at +91 932 797 4224.

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

Why Inspire

## Specialty supply is a clinical decision — we treat it that way.

Specialty medicines aren't ordinary stock. A delayed oncology cycle, a missed dialysis session, an
ICU drug that didn't make it through customs — each one shows up in patient outcomes.

Inspire was built to remove those failures from the supply side. We focus narrowly on four specialty
areas, we keep the same molecules in stock month after month, and we are accountable for the chain
from manufacturer to hospital pharmacy.

[More about Inspire][20]
What we do for clinicians and procurement

## Registered. Sourced. Delivered — to clinical specification.

We are organised around what hospital pharmacy, oncology day-care units, dialysis centres and tender
boards actually need: a known supplier, a registered product, and dependable lead time.

### Scientific office support

Our in-house medical team works directly with prescribers — protocol fit, mechanism of action,
contraindications and SmPC documentation. Specialty supply backed by clinical understanding, not
just a sales call.

### Cold-chain reliability

Biologics, plasma-derived therapies and selected oncology agents are handled with
temperature-controlled logistics, transit monitoring and conditioned warehousing — verified at
hospital goods-in.

### Hospital & tender supply

Direct supply to private & public hospitals, oncology day-care units, dialysis providers, and county
/ national pharmaceutical tenders.

[Full capabilities][21]
Built around the prescriber

## The people who choose the medicine are the people we work for.

Oncologists, nephrologists, hospital pharmacists, intensivists, procurement officers — these are the
audiences our scientific office, regulatory team and supply chain are designed around.

If you are one of them and you need product information, supply confirmation or a tender response,
our team is one enquiry away.

## "Strive not to be a success, but rather to be of value!"

### Khandelwal Associates is a Pharmaceutical Logistics Company, established in the year 1989.
### Providing services to more than 700 clients since 33 years. The firm majors in four services
### which are Carrying and Forwarding Agency Consignee Agency, Distributorship and Mother Warehouse
### Facility. Infrastructure with ultra-modern IT facilities and spacious warehouses. Provision of

* 1989 : Our company was incorporated as Khandelwal Associatel, established in year 1989, as a
  Pharmaceutical Company in Indore. The foundation of our enterprise were laid with a passionate
  vision and the aim to achieve unparalleled success.
* 1995 : After years of conscientious practice in Pharmaceutical Business, we became associated with
  one of the top firms in the Pharmaceutical field, Emcure Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd.
* 2003 - 2004 : We established our main head office in indore with in house facilities for
  hospitality, support, operations, cold chain facilities, material handeling and three warehouses.
  Also got associated with Zuventus Healthcare Ltd.
* 2005 : Association with Medopharm Pharmaceuticals.
* 2008 - 2011 : Collaborated with Adley Labs, Gennova Biopharmaceuticals, Cachet Pharmaceuticals
  Private Limited and Talent Healthcare.
* 2013 - 2014 : We became C&F agents for Koey Pharmaceuticals and also became Adley Mother Warehouse
  Facility.

## Services

"To give real service you must add something which cannot be bought or measured with money, and that
is sincerity and integrity."

#### Carrying & Forwarding Agent

As a carrying and forwarding agent receiving the goods from the factories, warehousing these goods,
receiving dispatch orders from the principal, and much more.

#### Consignee Agent

As a consignee agent, the company's name is reflected in the consignee column in the bill of lading
or in other words the “buyer” of the cargo.

#### Mother Warehouse Facility

A mother warehouse is a commercial building for storage of goods. Mother Warehouses are used by
exporters, wholesalers, transport businesses, etc.

#### Distributorship

It’s about getting the right medicines to the right patients at the right time, safely and
efficiently. Primary distributors sustain a complex supply chain.

**WELCOME TO MINTAGE JOURNALS (E-ISSN 2320-3315)**

Mintage journals accepts new technologies, or research or research methods with applicability to
pharmacy practice in fields such as pharmaceutical care, medication therapy management,
Pharmaceutical Technology, Pharmacognosy, Natural Product Research, Pharmaceutics, Novel Drug
Delivery, Biopharmaceutics, Pharmacokinetics, Pharmaceutical/Medicinal Chemistry, Computational
Chemistry and Molecular Drug Design, Pharmacology, Pharmaceutical Analysis, Pharmacy Practice,
Clinical and Hospital Pharmacy, Cell Biology, Genomics and Proteomics, Pharmacogenomics,
Bioinformatics and Biotechnology of Pharmaceutical Interest , Medical science ,APHE , Organ system,
psychosocial aspects of medication use, pharmacoeconomics, pharmacotherapy, pharmacoepidemiology,
pharmacy law, pharmacy management, public health, and health care financing.

**Fast Editorial Execution and Review Process (FEE-Review Process) : **

Mintage Journal of pharmaceutical And Medical Sciences is participating in the Fast Editorial
Execution and Review Process (FEE-Review Process) with an additional prepayment of $99 apart from
the regular article processing fee.

[replica rolex][9]

Fast Editorial Execution and Review Process is a special service for the article that enables it to
get a faster response in the pre-review stage from the handling editor as well as a review from the
reviewer. An author can get a faster response of pre-review maximum in 3 days since submission, and
a review process by the reviewer maximum in 5 days, followed by revision/publication in 2 days. If

## Nanoforming Biologics & GLP-1s: From I.V. to Sub Q & Inhaled Delivery

Designing the most patient-centric and effective treatment options are key for those pharmaceutical
companies developing and marketing high value biological therapies. Nanoforming biologics and
peptides simplifies dose regimens and unlocks new delivery routes to enhance patient comfort,
compliance and reduce healthcare costs.

[ Learn more ][131]

## Improving bioavailability

Many of the latest generation of small molecule drugs in development exhibit increased molecular
weights and lipophilicity. Today’s novel, complex molecules present not only biopharmaceutical
challenges such as poor solubility and bioavailability, but also handling and manufacturing
challenges.

[ Learn more ][132]

## Enabling Subcutaneous Delivery for Improved Patient Compliance & Healthcare System Efficiencies

Nanoform Biologics’ high-dose subcutaneous delivery platform represents a significant advancement in
the field of biologics.

[ Learn more ][133]

## Expanding Opportunities for Inhaled Drug Delivery

Whether to treat localised respiratory disease, or because the lung provides a fast, non-invasive,
and efficient route of delivery for systemic effect, the administration of pharmaceuticals to the
lung is gaining increased attention; even beyond treatments for globally prevalent diseases like
asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD).

### About our parent company

[ [Sekhmet_Logo] ][47]

In May 2022, [Sekhmet Pharmaventures][48] acquired a majority stake in Optimus Drugs Group of
Companies, marking a pivotal step in our evolution.

Sekhmet Pharmaventures Pvt. Ltd. (part of Gamot API Pte Ltd. based in Singapore) was formed by Asian
private equity major PAG, along with Indian private equity firms, CX Partners and Samara Capital.
The three has formed an investment platform called Gamot API Pte. Ltd. based in Singapore, with the
aim to buy stakes in fast-growing pharma companies. Sekhmet Pharmaventures continues to combine
inorganic endeavors together with organic growth activities, in order to form a leading Pharma
platform in the spaces of intermediates, API, Finished Dosage Formulations and CMO & CDMO services.

### About our parent company

[ [Sekhmet_Logo] ][47]

In May 2022, [Sekhmet Pharmaventures][48] acquired a majority stake in Optimus Drugs Group of
Companies, marking a pivotal step in our evolution.

Sekhmet Pharmaventures Pvt. Ltd. (part of Gamot API Pte Ltd. based in Singapore) was formed by Asian
private equity major PAG, along with Indian private equity firms, CX Partners and Samara Capital.
The three has formed an investment platform called Gamot API Pte. Ltd. based in Singapore, with the
aim to buy stakes in fast-growing pharma companies. Sekhmet Pharmaventures continues to combine
inorganic endeavors together with organic growth activities, in order to form a leading Pharma
platform in the spaces of intermediates, API, Finished Dosage Formulations and CMO & CDMO services.

## Three decades of innovation in drug delivery & product development

1995

Orexo is founded in Uppsala, Sweden, as a drug delivery company. Development begins based on
first-generation drug delivery technology – the sublingual platform

2000

Diabact® UBT, for diagnosing Helicobacter pylori, receives first market approval and is
commercialized through a partner

2008

Abstral®, for breakthrough cancer pain, launches in its first market via partnership

2009

Edluar®, for insomnia, achieves first market approval and is commercialized through partnership

2013

Zubsolv®, the third product based on the sublingual platform, is approved by the FDA for the
treatment of opioid addiction. Orexo establishes a US subsidiary for commercialization

2016

Zubsolv in the US surpasses SEK 1 billion in gross sales

2017

Research into an overdose rescue medication started, leading to the development of next-generation
drug delivery technology - AmorphOX®

2021

Pipeline expands with three clinical-phase programs and several preclinical projects all leveraging
AmorphOX technology

2024

Clinical expansion in the development of a powder-based nasal anaphylaxis product. In parallel,
Orexo expands research in peptides and vaccines.

2025

Orexo divests all rights to Zubsolv in the US, unlocking resources to accelerate development
programs

### Product Range


#### Tablets

Pharmaceutical tablets are a widely used form of medication delivery in the healthcare industry.
These small, solid, and easily consumable pills are designed to contain specific active ingredients
that provide therapeutic effects. The content of these tablets can vary greatly depending on the
intended use of the medication.


#### Syrups

Pharmaceutical syrups play a crucial role in the healthcare industry, serving as a convenient and
effective way to deliver medications to patients. These liquid formulations are specially designed
to ensure accurate dosing and ease of administration, making them particularly suitable for
children, elderly individuals.


#### Ointment

Ointments are specialized semi-solid formulations applied to the skin or mucous membranes for
various therapeutic or protective purposes. At Richberg Healthcare Pvt. Ltd , we follow rigorous
manufacturing processes to ensure the highest quality in every batch of ointments produced.


#### Respules

"Respules" refers to a specific form of nebulizer medication, typically in a liquid-filled ampoule,
that is designed for inhalation to treat respiratory conditions like asthma or chronic obstructive
pulmonary disease (COPD). These are often produced by pharmaceutical companies specializing in
respiratory care and medications.


#### Capsules

Capsules are a widely used pharmaceutical dosage form, known for their convenience and effectiveness
in delivering medication to patients. These small, cylindrical containers consist of two halves,
typically made of gelatin or a suitable alternative material, that encase the active ingredients in
a precise and measured manner.


#### Injection

Injection manufacturing, particularly for pharmaceuticals, involves stringent processes to ensure
sterility, accuracy, and efficacy. Injectable medications are commonly used for rapid, controlled
delivery of drugs, and they require precise manufacturing steps due to their direct delivery into
the bloodstream, muscles, or tissues.

### Sustainable Practices for a Greener Future

We are committed to minimizing our environmental footprint by integrating eco-conscious practices
into our production and supply chain. From investing in energy-efficient technologies to reducing
water usage and chemical waste, we actively pursue greener processes without compromising quality or
compliance.

Governance

### Integrity and Accountability in Action

We maintain rigorous compliance standards, transparent reporting, and ethical business practices
across our global operations. From quality control to cybersecurity, our governance framework
ensures accountability and risk management at every level.

Social

### Empowering Communities and People Wordwide

People are at the heart of everything we do, and we collaborate with our partners and communities to
promote health, education, and opportunity. Ethical labor practices, ongoing workforce development,

# Living our mission of creating healthier, happier communities globally

[Zydus Srishti][15]

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Major Areas of Research

[NCE Research] **NCE Research**
* Cardio-Metabolic
* Inflammation and Immunology,
* Neurosciences, Oncology, Rare Diseases
[Biologics] **Biologics**
* Biosimilar Therapeutic proteins
* Biosimilar Monoclonal antibodies
* Biobetters and Novel biologics
[Vaccines] **Vaccines**
* Infectious diseases
[View More][20]

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.
